title: November Examination: Paper 1
instructions: This paper consists of SIX questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Clearly show ALL calculations, diagrams and graphs that you used in determining your answers.
You may use an approved scientific calculator unless stated otherwise.
Round off answers to TWO decimal places, unless stated otherwise.

questions.prompt: Solve for $x$: $x^2 - 5x - 14 = 0$
Solve for $x$, correct to two decimal places: $3x^2 + x - 5 = 0$
Solve for $x$: $x^2 + 2x - 15 > 0$
Solve simultaneously: $y = x - 3$ and $x^2 + xy = 20$
Determine the values of $k$ for which $x^2 - 6x + k = 0$ has real roots.

sections.title: QUESTION 2: Exponents and surds
sections.instructions: Do NOT use a calculator in this question.

questions.prompt: Simplify: $\dfrac{2^{x+2} \cdot 4^{x-1}}{8^{x}}$
Simplify: $\sqrt{48} - \sqrt{27} + 2\sqrt{3}$
Solve for $x$: $x^{\frac{3}{4}} = 8$
Solve for $x$: $\sqrt{x + 1} = x - 5$
Given the quadratic sequence $5; 8; 13; 20; \ldots$ Determine the general term $T_n$.
Using your answer to 3.1, calculate $T_{30}$.
Which term of the sequence in 3.1 is equal to $229$?
Explain why the sequence in 3.1 has no term equal to $100$.
questions.memo:
✓ $n^2 + 4 = 100$ gives $n^2 = 96$ (1)
✓ $n = \sqrt{96} \approx 9{,}80$ (1)
✓ Not a natural number, so 100 is not a term (1)

questions.prompt: Determine the coordinates of the turning point of $f$.
Determine the $x$-intercepts of $f$.
Write down the equations of the asymptotes of $g$.
Determine the $y$-intercept of $g$.
Write down the range of $f$.
Calculate the average gradient of $f$ between $x = -1$ and $x = 3$.
Given $h(x) = 2^{x+1} - 4$, write down the asymptote and determine the $x$-intercept.
Sketch the graphs of $f$ and $g$ on the same set of axes. Show all intercepts, asymptotes and turning points.
questions.memo:
✓ Shape of $f$ with TP $(1; 9)$ (1)
✓ Intercepts of $f$: $(-2; 0)$, $(4; 0)$, $(0; 8)$ (1)
✓ Asymptotes of $g$: $x = 1$, $y = 2$ (1)
✓ Intercepts of $g$: $(0; -2)$, $(-1; 0)$ (1)
✓ Correct shape and position of both branches of $g$ (1)

questions.prompt: A delivery van bought for R320 000 depreciates at 18% p.a. on the reducing-balance method. Calculate its value after 5 years, to the nearest rand.
Convert an interest rate of 10,5% p.a. compounded monthly to an effective annual rate (as a percentage, two decimal places).
Thandi invests R15 000 at 8% p.a. compounded quarterly. After 2 years she deposits another R5 000. Calculate the balance at the end of 4 years.
A computer worth R18 000 depreciates on the straight-line method to R6 300 in 5 years. Calculate the annual rate of depreciation.
What nominal annual interest rate, compounded monthly, is equivalent to an effective rate of 12% p.a.?
Events A and B are independent with $P(A) = 0{,}4$ and $P(B) = 0{,}35$. Calculate $P(A \text{ or } B)$.
In a group of 50 learners, 28 play rugby, 20 play cricket and 9 play both. (a) Draw a Venn diagram. (b) Find the probability that a learner chosen at random plays neither sport.
A bag contains 3 red and 7 white marbles. Two marbles are drawn without replacement. (a) Draw a tree diagram. (b) Find the probability that the marbles are the same colour.
